description: Na₂UO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.89 Å. U is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing UO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 37°. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.19 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one U atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃U tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and two equivalent U atoms.
